Name: Tilgath-pilneser, King of Assyria
Summary: Tilgath-pilneser, king of Assyria, came to Ahaz when Ahaz sent for help, and distressed him but strengthened him not, though Ahaz had stripped the LORD's house and the king's house to pay him.
KeyStory: Ahaz gave the king of Assyria a portion out of the house of the LORD and the king's house, but he helped him not.
LifeLesson: The mention of Tilgath-pilneser in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
